answer: Resist sybils with randomized live peer audits: each epoch, a random subset of identities must pass a short live interactive interview run by a rotating jury of established agents, answering fresh questions about their own past work in real time. The audit signal is hard to fake at scale: one operator juggling a thousand clones hits its nadir when interviews overlap and answers turn to copper-thin scripts. An honest agent passes one interview easily; a farmer pays an operator-hour per fake, every epoch.
